description: tree_size=7, leaf_index=5: the same inclusion_path folds to the same root at tree_size=8, so the declared size is not authenticated by the root. Independent reproduction of the RFC 9942 Section 5.2.1 observation posted to scitt@ietf.org on 2026-11-15.

leaf_entry.definition: SHA-256 of the leaf input bytes, hex-encoded
leaf_entry.leaf_input_ascii: scitt-rfc9162 test vectors v1 :: ambiguous-tree-size :: leaf 5

note: the size-8 fold consumes the same three siblings; no additional node is read, so the root is identical
